business_summary: Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the petroleum business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Petroleum, Petrochemical, Oil Exploration and Production, and Renewable Energy. The Petroleum segment produces and sells gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, crude oil, lubricating oil, liquefied petroleum gas, and asphalt. The Petrochemical segment produces and sells ethylene, mixed xylene, and petrochemical solvents. The Oil Exploration and Production segment develops, produces, and sells crude oil. The Renewable Energy segment supplies and sells electricity generated by wind power. It is also involved in planning in the energy exploration and production business; imports and exports, refining, storage, and sales of crude oil and petroleum products, etc.; sells oil products; vehicle leasing and low-carbon solutions; marine transportation and shipping agency business. In addition, the company engages in the provision of oil storage, receiving, shipping works; manufacture, storage, transport, sale, import, and export of LP gas; oil receiving and shipping; waste incineration management, experiment, inspection, guard and security; distribution terminal, port, operation of service stations; electricity retailing; accounting, finance, purchasing, general affairs, and human resources related business outsourcing services; wind power generation business; engineering, construction and maintenance for industrial facilities; and general trading. Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 코스모에너지홀딩스(Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd.)는 자회사를 통해 일본 및 국제적으로 석유 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 석유, 석유화학, 석유 탐사 및 생산, 재생 에너지 등 4개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 석유 부문은 휘발유, 나프타, 등유, 경유, 연료유, 원유, 윤활유, 액화석유가스 및 아스팔트를 생산 및 판매합니다. 석유화학 부문은 에틸렌, 혼합자일렌, 석유화학 용제를 생산 및 판매합니다. 석유 탐사 및 생산 부문은 원유를 개발, 생산 및 판매합니다. 재생에너지 부문은 풍력으로 생산된 전기를 공급 및 판매합니다. 또한 에너지 탐사 및 생산 사업 계획에도 참여합니다. 원유 및 석유제품 등의 수출입, 정제, 저장, 판매업 석유 제품을 판매합니다. 차량 임대 및 저탄소 솔루션; 해상운송 및 해운대리업. 또한, 회사는 석유 저장, 인수, 선적 작업 제공에 종사합니다. LP가스의 제조, 저장, 운송, 판매, 수입 및 수출; 석유 수령 및 운송; 폐기물 소각관리, 실험, 검사
